verdict.rationale: Claude Code exposes a documented Agent SDK for programmatic control, supports ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-based direct API access, offers CLI scriptability (headless/CI use, piping), and can itself run as an MCP server for other apps to connect to. This gives ai-native users multiple documented, first-party programmatic interfaces. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the Agent SDK's completeness or stability, and no detailed API reference/versioning docs beyond overview mentions.
